string.text: Your mods don't match the host's. Check the log (appdata\logs) for the list of differing files. Both players must run the same modpack.
Your xrRazom version doesn't match the host's. Both players must run the same version.

Your game world doesn't match the host's. The two installs were built from different spawn data, so the same object would have different IDs on each machine. Both players must run the same game build.

Your install has the same network identity as the host's. This happens when one install was copied from the other. Delete appdata\xrrazom_lan_id.bin in your game folder and restart - a new identity is generated automatically.
Host loaded a save without your character data
Gameplay and progression difficulty are session rules set by the host.
Managed by the host while in a co-op session.
All players must be within 4 meters to sleep.
All players must be within %s meters to travel.
Fast travel settings are session rules set by the host.
You have no money to send
Player is no longer in the game
No players to send money to
Name '%s' is already taken by another player
Name '%s' is already taken by the host
Name '%s' belongs to an offline player of this world
DANGER ZONE -- use at your own risk
These are session rules; the host sets them for everyone.
Nickname shown to other players. The host validates it on join and on rename, so a name already in use is refused.
Show player markers on PDA map
Draw a map spot for every connected player on your PDA.
Display each player's nickname floating above their avatar in the world.
Display a list of connected players with a thin health bar in the top-right of the HUD.
On-screen warning when the connection degrades (high latency, packet loss, or no response). Diagnostics are still written to the log when disabled.
How long your ping tag stays visible to everyone. Bind the ping key in Settings -> Control -> Keybinds (xrRazom Co-op).
Enable the in-game co-op text chat. Bind the chat key in Settings -> Control -> Keybinds (xrRazom Co-op); press it to open the input box. Messages appear bottom-left for everyone in the session.
Play a short blip when a chat message arrives from another player (never for your own). Volume follows the game's effects-volume setting.
Allow players to damage each other. When disabled, player-on-player hits are suppressed.
A lethal hit leaves a player wounded and crawling instead of dead, and a teammate can rescue them. When disabled, players die as in single player.

A rescue spends one of the rescuer's medkits and gives its effects to the rescued player. When disabled, a rescue needs no medkit: none is spent and no medkit effects are applied, even if the rescuer carries one.
Allow connected players to request quicksave and load-last-save on the host.
Maximum number of other players who can join your hosted session.
When a quest or dialog teleports you, pull nearby teammates along to the same destination. Disable to keep teleports local (vanilla behaviour).
Teammates within this distance of you (when you trigger a teleport) are teleported too. 0 = everyone on your level. Uses your setting as the initiator.
Require whole party for fast travel
Fast travel requires every player within the gather radius below. The host's value applies to the whole session.
Fast travel and time-skip books require every player within this distance of the one starting them. The host's value applies to the whole session.
Automatically open a co-op session when you load into the game. Required for other players to be able to connect to you.

Let other players connect to you via your Steam ID instead of an IP address -- supports NAT traversal and Friends overlay invites. Disable for direct LAN/IP hosting via the port below (Steam's networking library is still used automatically whenever Steam is running).
UDP port for direct LAN/IP connections. Only used when Steam networking is disabled.

Let players join even when their mod/config set differs from yours. Use at your own risk: mismatched mods can desync or crash the session, and no support is given for such sessions. The mismatch is still written to your log.
Someone is already dressing this body
You are wounded - a teammate can rescue you
The host cannot save right now
That player name is already in use in this session
The session was lost while loading - returning to the main menu
The host did not send your character data in time - returning to the main menu
